0x000800.en: 「At my level...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x0008F9.en: 「Dammit!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A22.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000A5A.en: 「Well, well...@　that was uncool of me!」

0x000B5E.en: 「Like hell I'll blow it here...!@　Not funny...」

0x000BB2.en: 「Blew it...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000C26.en: 「Ugh! No choice but to fall back!!」

0x000D03.en: 「This is as far as I go... the rest is yours.」

0x000D71.en: 「Nngh! Did they get the drop on me...?」

0x000DAF.en: 「No good, took too many hits... I'm retreating!」

0x000DFC.en: 「This is trouble. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E3A.en: 「Kyah! The rest is up to you!」

0x000E81.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F2C.en: 「Ugh... so I become a shooting star... I'm ejecting!」

0x0010D5.en: 「Ugh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x00111C.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x001151.en: 「Damn it! Is this as far as my power goes...!」

0x00123D.en: 「To be taken down in a place like this...@　I'm still too green...!」

0x00128B.en: 「No good, I can't hold out! Retreating!」

0x001346.en: 「Sorry, I'm leaving the rest to you!」

0x001375.en: 「N-No good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013B3.en: 「Well, well, so this is the end.」

0x0013E2.en: 「I can't manage any more. I'll take my leave.」

0x00146D.en: 「Was I careless...@　I'll pull back here...!」

0x0014EA.en: 「Tch...! I can't hold out after all...!」

0x0015D3.en: 「I'm bailing out...@　Ngh...! Can't even do it gracefully...」

0x001691.en: 「Nnngh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x0018D5.en: 「Guess I've no choice but to fall back...!」

0x00198E.en: 「Dressed like that, no wonder you're freezing.@　Hurry up and put on your cold-weather gear.」

0x0019E7.en: 「I-I know that!@　I couldn't put it on inside the cockpit!@　I was busy running the DFC!」

0x001A7A.en: 「Quit your grumbling and hurry up.@　You'll get frostbite.」

0x001ACD.en: 「And what about you? You're fine?@　Your hands and feet don't go numb? Are you made of iron or something?」

0x001B5D.en: 「Wh-What's wrong...? Did I say something to upset you?」

0x001C08.en: (Th-That kid's dressed light too, and she's fine... is it because she's young?)

0x001CBD.en: 「Yeah... we managed to avoid running into any Guests.」

0x001CFA.en: 「Brr, that was cold. I'll go make some cocoa.@　You'll have some too, right, big brother?」

0x001D68.en: 「Don't make it too strong.@　...So, is the old man still holed up downstairs?」

0x001DCA.en: 「That's right, he brought in Sympatia 02.@　Seems he's close to opening the gate.」

0x001E3E.en: 「The gate... the thing the old man called Foris?@　Just what kind of thing is it?」

0x001EA9.en: 「Who knows...@　I've never been to the depths of the lowest level myself.」

0x001EFF.en: 「The depths?@　Don't tell me it was discovered@　while we were out there?」

0x001F62.en: 「Yeah.@　That's why we need the Aile Chevalier.@　For the survey... and in case of emergency.」

0x001FEC.en: 「And the Blanche Neige?@　You've got it ready too, right?」

0x002042.en: 「...Better safe than sorry, as they say.」

0x00207C.en: 「Whatever anyone says, I won't let Lim near that thing...」

0x0020B9.en: 「But the Blanche Neige@　can only be piloted by her.」

0x00211F.en: 「Here, cocoa. Sorry, bro.@　Cris made it a bit too strong.」

0x0021B2.en: 「I was thinking of making some for everyone too...@　Cliff, how about you?」

0x002214.en: 「Yeah, I'll take some. I prefer it strong.」

0x00224E.en: 「Right, that's you. Hold on a sec.」

0x002282.en: 「Joshua... is she still like that?@　I mean, are they?」

0x0022E7.en: 「Yeah...@　I thought leaving here might change things a little.」

0x00233D.en: 「Still no telling which is the real Cliana...」

0x002396.en: 「They themselves don't mind it.@　As if they'd always been that way...」

0x0023FB.en: 「But I can't just let it go.@　Now that I know my old man caused it,@　there's no way I can stay calm about it.」

0x002497.en: 「That was before I came here, so I don't know the details...」

0x0024DD.en: 「Everyone involved keeps their mouths shut.@ I can't trust them. That's why I@ took Lim and got out of here...!」

0x002597.en: 「Did you explain her situation to Ensign Hugo@　and the Steel Dragon Squadron?」

0x0025FC.en: 「No... they haven't noticed yet.@　I told Cris and Riana to keep quiet.」

0x002670.en: 「They'll find out sooner or later.@　Better to tell them before they get suspicious.@　It's for their sake too.」

0x002790.en: 「Um... did you have a fight with Hugo?」

0x0027F2.en: 「But they say you only fight with those you're close to, right?」

0x002838.en: 「He's just a partner, that's all.@　Besides, I don't go for younger guys.」

0x0028D4.en: 「Yes, I think he's wonderful.@ What's your type, Lim?」

0x0029A1.en: (Cris, your cocoa's getting cold, you know?)

0x0029F4.en: 「...I've seen the Demon data.@　If that thing is after@　the Aile Chevalier...」

0x002A78.en: 「The reason would be either Sympatia@　or the Race Arcana, one of the two.」

0x002ADD.en: 「You mean two unknowns drawn to each other?」

0x002B11.en: 「Something like that.@　Depending on the case, it could be the key to the mystery...」

0x002B65.en: 「An alarm...!@　Something's happened at Fabra Foris.」

0x002BBB.en: 「The line to the underground's cut off.@　And we're detecting a high-energy reading.」

0x002C51.en: 「Joshua, take the Aile Chevalier@　and go check it out.」

0x002CCC.en: 「I'll request Ensign Hugo's team to sortie too.@　Be careful out there.」

0x002D8D.en: 「Ensign Hugo, that's the entrance to the ruins.」

0x002DF2.en: 「But the underground energy reading@　keeps climbing...!」

0x002E91.en: 「Ripples of energy spreading out@　centered on Fabra Foris... I've never seen@　anything like it, but if I had to say...」

0x002F33.en: 「It resembles the ES wave@　from when the <Einst> teleported in.」

0x002FA7.en: 「It only resembles it - that doesn't mean it's Einst.@　But we can assume an anomaly@　on the same level is occurring.」

0x003040.en: 「But the Einst were completely wiped out, weren't they?」

0x003089.en: 「The pure ones, yes. But traces remain.@　Ensign Excellen's Rein Weissritter...@　and the Red Ogre.」

0x003131.en: 「During the Inspector incident, the Einst@　attacked here several times. It can't be, but...」

0x0031AB.en: 「Did they ever teleport@　directly inside the ruins?」

0x003233.en: 「Either way,@　all we can do is go in and investigate.」

0x003283.en: 「Sorry for dragging you into our family mess.」

0x0032CF.en: 「It's not the first time I've gotten stuck@　with a project I can't make sense of. Don't worry about it.」

0x00333D.en: 「Cliff, we're heading down now.@　Handle the evacuation of the Mother Base staff@　and try to reach my father and the others.」

0x0033D0.en: 「Heat-source reading and tremors...!@　There's an explosion underground!」

0x003451.en: 「Wait!@　Multiple moving contacts! Deep in the ruins entrance!」

0x0034C4.en: 「The aura's like the Einst, but different...@ A phantom mecha-being?」

0x003548.en: 「N-No, things like those...@　In all our surveys, not even a trace...!」

0x0035A7.en: 「So they're making a move!@　Aqua, send the Steel Dragon Squadron footage of them!」

0x003619.en: 「Damn it! Old man, just what did you do!?」

0x0036B8.en: 「Hugo, there's a unit closing in on us!」

0x003745.en: 「Sorry to keep you waiting, bro! I'll fight too!」

0x0037E5.en: 「I told you, in case of emergency.」

0x003819.en: 「But Lim's never seen real combat!@ This is reckless!」

0x003863.en: 「Her sync with the system is good.@　The way she is now... she can do it.」

0x0038B6.en: 「You know full well!@ If you make Lim use Sympatia any more...!」

0x003924.en: 「Bro, don't worry.@　This one's moving just fine for me.@　We've got to hurry to father and the others!」

0x0039B4.en: 「All right... just don't do anything reckless.」

0x0039F1.en: (Lim... something feels different...@ And she called Joshua "bro"...)

0x003AC4.en: (C-Cliana~! They just keep pouring out from inside!)

0x003B0D.en: 「We can't get down there like this!」

0x003B6C.en: 「...can you...ar me, Mother...personnel...@ Get away from the Antarctic, now...」

0x003C20.en: 「...Joshua, is it...? What did you come here for...」

0x003C5D.en: 「What did we come for!? @ You're the one who called us here!」

0x003CAD.en: 「And dragged us into an accident on top of it! @ We came to save you, so where are you!?」

0x003D1B.en: 「The Fabula Foris has opened... @ Just as I thought...」

0x003E28.en: 「Get out... run... @ Soon, this whole Antarctic...」

0x003E72.en: 「What's going to happen to the Antarctic!? @ What's going on down there!?」

0x003F08.en: 「Forgive you!? @ Now, of all times!? That almost sounds like...!」

0x003FB7.en: 「A spherical high-energy mass is expanding underground! @ At this rate, it'll swallow us too!」

0x004034.en: 「So this is where it ends...! @ Joshua, Cliana! We're pulling out!」

0x0040A9.en: 「...I'm going in. @ Cliana, you escape with Lieutenant Hugo and the others!」

0x004102.en: 「No way! You can't go in alone, Bro!」

0x004133.en: 「Someone has to find out what's happening in there! @ You go with Lieutenant Hugo!」

0x0041B7.en: 「Heh heh heh, so this is my body... my vessel...」

0x0041FA.en: 「A-a voice... I can hear a voice...!!」

0x004238.en: 「So a form like this excites negative emotion... @ that wave of feeling, does it?」

0x004294.en: 「Yes... their knowledge and their images shaped us.」

0x0042DE.en: 「This form... I find it quite to my liking, heh heh heh.」

0x004321.en: 「And those are this world's holders of knowledge, @ the 'people,' the 'humans' who are our sustenance... @ so they call themselves.」

0x0043D3.en: 「It seems some among them have touched the Key as well.」

0x004444.en: 「Humans, carve new knowledge into your flesh. @ We are the 'Ruina'...」

0x0044A3.en: 「Those who bring you fear, despair, and ruin.」

0x004536.en: 「Joshua! Cliana! @ Who are you two talking to!?」

0x00458C.en: 「!? @ You can't hear them? Their voices!?」

0x0045D6.en: 「Now then... first we seal this land of ice, @ and prepare for the next rite.」

0x00466A.en: 「Tch, that's far enough! @ Joshua, Cliana! We're getting out of here!」

0x004703.en: 「That bastard old man, says his piece and @ that's it, it's over! He's too selfish!」

0x004780.en: 「Look at the situation! @ And we have to get the people at Mother Base @ out of here too!」

0x0047F8.en: 「We have a duty to report what we saw here...! @ I'll drag you back by force if I have to.」

0x0048A4.en: 「All right, full speed astern! Don't fall behind!」

0x004906.en: Paris - Earth Federation Army Joint Chiefs of Staff

0x004934.en: Earth Federation Army Joint Chiefs of Staff

0x004969.en: 「Good grief... a second coming of the <Antarctic Incident>, is it?」

0x0049B8.en: 「However, this doesn't seem to involve aliens. @ An invisible half-dome field is expanding @ near the south magnetic pole.」

0x004A72.en: 「At this rate, the Antarctic continent itself @　may be swallowed up by it.」

0x004AE3.en: 「And the hostiles? Who made first contact?」

0x004B2C.en: 「A test pilot on loan to the Special Tactics @ Combat Instructor Squad of the Far East Army.」

0x004B91.en: 「This intel was relayed via the Steel Dragon Squadron @ and Far East Army Headquarters.」

0x004BFF.en: 「The Steel Dragon Squadron and the Instructor Squad... @ Always mixed up in this sort of incident, that lot.」

0x004C73.en: 「The hostiles have split into roughly three groups. Alpha is @ moving across the Antarctic Peninsula toward @ Chile and Cape Horn...」

0x004D12.en: 「San Martin Base and Rothera Base @ came under attack and have gone silent.」

0x004D74.en: 「Bravo is crossing the Ross Sea toward New Zealand, @ and Charlie is moving from Cape Poinsett @ out over the Pacific.」

0x004E25.en: 「The Pacific Fleet's 3rd Carrier Strike Group @ was en route to Grand Christmas, correct?」

0x004ECA.en: 「Send them to the Antarctic at full speed. @ And the New Zealand, Chile, and Argentina units?」

0x004F44.en: 「Already in intercept posture. @ And the Gaia Sabers air-combat carrier group that left @ Paris has apparently turned toward the Antarctic.」

0x004FEF.en: 「Hmph, eager beavers. @ They're not heading into a war zone @ with President Grusman still aboard, surely?」

0x0050A7.en: 「If the Gaia Sabers are moving, @ send the Steel Dragon Squadron to the Antarctic as well. @ Their ship should make it in time.」

0x005177.en: 「Yes... we need to make our presence felt too.」
